records.application_move: Make this 48-track intelligence plane the live bridge from estate evidence to targeted application packages.
records.how_learned: The authenticated estate audit found 1,179 live repositories, 1,114 beyond the old 67-repository baseline, 32 capability families, and explicit review queues.
records.inferred_bottleneck: Semantic review, duplicate and legacy reconciliation, runnable proof, cross-repository integration, and presentation without overclaiming.
records.inferred_brick_wall: Converting massive breadth into trusted depth while provider quotas, private-source opacity, verification debt, and fragmented history remain.

leverage.expected_impact: Turns repository volume into company-specific systems, closes evidence gaps, and improves application credibility.
leverage.mechanism: Use Helix as authority, Diamond topology for depth, Gatling waves for throughput, compact memory for reuse, and proof-weighted promotion.

records.next_deep_dive: Run source-code deep dives on repositories attached to the highest-priority tracks and promote only verified systems.
records.observed_current_pressure: A 1,179-repository estate must become a small number of coherent, proof-bearing systems that recruiters and engineers can inspect.

official_sources.observed_signal: Large recovered estate with zero-omission inventory but continuing semantic and executable-proof work.
